serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `vscode-html-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

customData.title: Custom Data
customData.description: HTML custom-data files that describe additional elements, attributes and values. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the HTML server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report errors from embedded styles and scripts in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer elements, attributes, values and closing tags.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show element and attribute documentation on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show signatures for embedded script calls.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Resolve links and references in the document.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List matching references in the document.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document symbols to navigation features.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format whole documents and selected ranges.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename matching opening and closing tags together.

html.title: HTML
html.description: Completion, hover, validation and formatting options sent to the language server.

attributeDefaultValue.title: Attribute Value Style
attributeDefaultValue.description: Value inserted when an attribute completion needs a value.

suggestHtml5.title: HTML5 Suggestions
suggestHtml5.description: Offer the standard HTML5 elements, attributes and values.

hideEndTagSuggestions.title: Hide End Tag Suggestions
hideEndTagSuggestions.description: Do not offer closing tags in the completion list.

validateScripts.title: Validate Embedded Scripts
validateScripts.description: Validate JavaScript embedded in HTML documents.

validateStyles.title: Validate Embedded Styles
validateStyles.description: Validate CSS embedded in HTML documents.

hoverDocumentation.title: Hover Documentation
hoverDocumentation.description: Include prose documentation in hover results.

hoverReferences.title: Hover References
hoverReferences.description: Include links to reference documentation in hover results.

format.title: Formatting
format.description: How the built-in formatter lays out HTML documents.

wrapLineLength.title: Wrap Line Length
wrapLineLength.description: Maximum line length before content is wrapped. Set to 0 to disable wrapping.

unformatted.title: Unformatted Elements
unformatted.description: Comma-separated element names whose tags are not reformatted.

contentUnformatted.title: Unformatted Content
contentUnformatted.description: Comma-separated element names whose inner content is not reformatted.

indentInnerHtml.title: Indent Inner HTML
indentInnerHtml.description: Indent the contents of `head` and `body` elements.

preserveNewLines.title: Preserve New Lines
preserveNewLines.description: Keep existing line breaks between elements.

maxPreserveNewLines.title: Maximum Preserved New Lines
maxPreserveNewLines.description: Maximum consecutive existing line breaks to preserve. Leave unset for no limit.

endWithNewline.title: Final Newline
endWithNewline.description: End a fully formatted document with a newline.

extraLiners.title: Extra Line Elements
extraLiners.description: Comma-separated tags before which an extra blank line is inserted.

wrapAttributes.title: Wrap Attributes
wrapAttributes.description: How attributes are wrapped across lines.

wrapAttributesIndentSize.title: Wrapped Attribute Indent
wrapAttributesIndentSize.description: Number of spaces used to indent wrapped attributes. Leave unset to follow the document indentation.

indentScripts.title: Script Indentation
indentScripts.description: How embedded script blocks are indented.

templating.title: Templating
templating.description: Preserve every templating syntax, disable templating support, or list the syntaxes to preserve.

unformattedContentDelimiter.title: Unformatted Content Delimiter
unformattedContentDelimiter.description: Text delimiter marking content the formatter must leave unchanged.
